original: Please stand, that's fine. Speaking of the final episode, I want to say that it's not just the two girls who don't want it to end.
translated: 請站著就好 沒關係 說到大結局 我想說的不只是兩位女孩捨不得結束

original: Now that we've reached the final episode, let's invite one more person to say goodbye. Boom? Oh, sorry, no.
translated: 既然都到了最後一集 那我們再邀請一位嘉賓來跟大家說再見 Boom 嗎 抱歉 不是啦

original: No, we haven't greeted the people upstairs yet. Come on, everyone upstairs, say bye-bye! Bye!
translated: 我們還沒跟樓上的朋友們打招呼 樓上的各位 快揮手說拜拜 拜拜

original: The sound from upstairs is really quiet. It's so quiet; we can't hear you down here.
translated: 樓上的聲音好小聲 真的太小聲了 我們在下面聽不太到

original: [Cheering] Can you hear them?
translated: 歡呼聲 大家聽到了嗎

original: Can you see us upstairs? We'll get to you in a moment.
translated: 樓上的看得到我們嗎 等等就換過去找你們

original: We can't see you or hear you. If you can't hear us, how can you answer? Yeah, that's true. How does that work? Anyway, what I was saying is, today...
translated: 我們看不到也聽不到 聽不到的話又怎麼能回答 對耶 這樣哪聽得到 總之我剛剛說的是 今天

original: The tickets were so hard to get. They sold out in no time because the fans wanted to come...
translated: 門票真的很難搶 一下子就秒殺了 因為粉絲們都想來現場

original: ...and watch the final episode with Lena and Miu. But now, let's talk about this episode. Please welcome...
translated: 和 Lena 還有 Miu 一起看大結局 既然說到這集 讓我們歡迎

original: ...one more person, someone who has worked so hard behind the scenes and made everything happen. P'Ao! P'Ao!
translated: 另一位在幕後付出非常多心血 讓這一切成真的大功臣 P'Ao P'Ao

original: Where is P'Ao, our producer? P'Ao! Where is Khun Patchanee?
translated: 我們的製作人 P'Ao 在哪裡 P'Ao Patchanee 在哪裡呢

original: Where is P'Ao? Patchanee! She's here, she's here! There she is. Let's hear it for her!
translated: P'Ao 在哪裡 Patchanee 她來了 她來了 她就在那裡 大家掌聲歡迎

original: Make some noise! [Cheering] Come on, let's go!
translated: 尖叫聲 歡呼聲 來吧 我們開始囉

original: You know her, right? [Cheering]
translated: 大家應該都認識她對吧 歡呼聲

original: Here she comes, our director!
translated: 我們的導演兼製作人走過來了

original: Careful, P'Ao, you might fall! Don't rush. You're not going to fall. [Music] Come over here.
translated: 小心點 P'Ao 小心跌倒 不用急 妳不會跌倒的 音樂 請往這邊走

original: [Music]
translated: 音樂

original: [Music] Hello, P'Ao! P'Ao said she's feeling shy.
translated: 音樂 哈囉 P'Ao P'Ao 說她覺得有點害羞

original: There are so many people here! And the reason it's so packed is because...
translated: 現場真的來了好多人 現場會這麼爆滿是因為

original: ...they want to celebrate P'Ao's and the girls' success.
translated: 大家都想來慶祝 P'Ao 還有兩位女孩的成功

original: They want to see my success! They also want to see your girls.
translated: 大家想來看我的成果 也想來見見妳們家這兩位女孩

original: And you were behind it all, too. So, P'Ao, how does it feel? Let me ask you, as the producer...
translated: 而且妳也是這一切背後的推手 P'Ao 身為製作人現在心情如何

original: ...now that we've made it all the way to the final episode. Can we get both of them to come up front?
translated: 如今一路順利走到大結局了 可以請她們兩位站前面一點嗎

original: Yes. I was worried that if I stood right here, too close to them, the fans wouldn't be able to take photos...
translated: 好的 我剛剛擔心如果我站在這裡離她們太近 粉絲們拍照會拍不到

original: ...of Miu because I'd end up blocking her face. And if I stood over here, I'd block you instead. So I was trying to move...
translated: 拍不到 Miu 因為我會把她的臉擋住 如果我站這邊又會擋到 Lena 所以我剛在喬位置

original: ...people around. How's that? What was the question again? [Laughter]
translated: 讓大家都能好好拍 剛剛的問題是什麼來著 笑聲

original: How does it feel now that we've reached the final episode? Honestly, I'm excited. I can't believe we're already at the final...
translated: 現在走到大結局心情如何 老實說真的很興奮 沒想到已經來到最後一集了

original: ...episode. It went by so quickly. Yes.
translated: 時間過得真的太快了 沒錯

original: And I still can't believe that we've come all this way, from the very first day...
translated: 我到現在依然不敢相信 我們從開拍第一天

original: ...until today. We've all been through so much together.
translated: 一路走到了今天 大家都一起經歷了好多好多

original: We believe that the people watching at home have only seen half of what we've experienced...
translated: 我們相信在螢幕前收看的觀眾 所感受到的可能只有我們親身經歷的一半

original: ...and what we've seen ourselves. Then why don't we show them everything?
translated: 既然這樣 那為什麼不把我們經歷的一切全都展現給他們看呢

original: I'd like to thank everyone who has supported the girls and supported this project from the very beginning...
translated: 我想藉這個機會 感謝從一開始就一路支持這兩位女孩 支持這個作品的每一位粉絲

original: ...all the way until today. Some of you have been with us since Safe Zone, too.
translated: 一路陪我們走到今天 甚至有些人從 Safe Zone 時期就一直支持到現在

original: Thank you so much. Let's hear it for her! [Applause] And now, let's hear from the girls.
translated: 真的非常感謝大家 大家給她熱烈掌聲 掌聲 接下來聽聽兩位女孩想說什麼

original: Speaking of the characters, today we're saying goodbye to them. Is there anything you'd like to say...
translated: 說到這兩個角色 今天要向角色道別了 有沒有什麼話想對角色說

original: ...to these two characters, Pim and Pa? What would you like to tell them, after being with them...
translated: 對這兩個角色 Pheem 和 Pan 陪伴了她們這麼久

original: ...since the very beginning? Do I have to say it now? P'Mew, you can speak. You can save it for the end.
translated: 從一開始陪伴至今 想對她們說些什麼 現在就要說了嗎 Miu 妳先說 還是妳想留到最後再說

original: Please, can I? I don't want to make everyone cry.
translated: 拜託 可以留到最後嗎 我不想現在就讓大家哭出來

original: Yes, don't say it now. P'Ao, I could lend you my sleeve, but I'm afraid it won't be enough. You'll need mine, too!
translated: 好 那現在先不說 P'Ao 我可以把我的衣袖借妳 但我怕不夠擦 妳還需要我的衣袖

original: Can I have a tissue, please? Oh!
translated: 可以給我一張衛生紙嗎 哎呀

original: Okay, okay, let's save that for later. Let P'Ao speak first.
translated: 好啦好啦 我們把感性的話留到後面 先讓 P'Ao 說

original: Can't I? Then, P'Nung, tell us about the characters we've nurtured since day one.
translated: 先不說嗎 那換 P'Nung 說說我們從第一天就用心呵護的角色吧

original: Filming wasn't just a matter of shooting for eight days and wrapping up. These characters really put us through it, didn't they, P'Wu?
translated: 拍攝可不是拍個八天就能收工 這兩個角色真的讓我們吃了不少苦頭 對吧 P'Wu

original: Let's start with you. We were there from the beginning, when we didn't even know what the team would be like yet.
translated: 那就先從妳開始 我們從最一開始就在了 那時甚至都還不知道整個團隊會長什麼樣子

original: We gradually learned about one another, how everyone worked, and how each person's pace and way of speaking were.
translated: 大家慢慢熟悉彼此 了解每個人的工作模式 還有每個人的步調與說話方式

original: We saw Pa when she was still doing really well, and then, once filming began, we saw how difficult her life had become...
translated: 我們看著 Pan 原本過得好好的 到開拍之後 看著她的生活變得多麼艱難

original: ...and how she slowly developed from being at rock bottom to finally getting back on her feet. And now, you can see where she is.
translated: 看著她如何從跌到谷底 一步一步重新振作站起來 直到今天大家看到的模樣

original: That's what everyone has seen today. [Applause]
translated: 這就是大家今天所看到的成果 掌聲

original: Are you ready to talk about the characters?
translated: 妳們準備好要聊聊角色了嗎

original: Go ahead. Do you want to talk about them? It's completely up to you.
translated: 說吧 妳們想聊聊角色嗎 完全看妳們想不想分享

original: It's entirely up to you. If you're afraid you'll cry, I'll skip the question. Can we skip it for now?
translated: 完全由妳們決定 如果怕會哭的話 我也可以先跳過這一題 可以先跳過嗎

original: [Laughter] Let's skip it.
translated: 笑聲 那我們先跳過這題好了

original: She's really attached to them. I understand. Sometimes, when you've spent so much time filming...
translated: 她對角色真的投入好深 我懂 有時候拍攝時間長了

original: ...you end up falling in love with the characters.
translated: 不知不覺就真的深深愛上了角色

original: Yes. On the first day we went to read the script, I thought, "Wow, this character is so cute and tiny."
translated: 沒錯 第一天去讀劇本的時候 我心裡就想 哇 這個角色也太小巧可愛了吧

original: Was that just you acting, or did you really feel that way? Yes, she's so fun to play. Can we start filming yet?
translated: 那時妳是在演戲 還是打從心底這麼覺得 真的 演這個角色超好玩 可以開始拍了嗎

original: Today? Uh...
translated: 今天嗎 呃

original: And when we finally went to shoot, it was so much fun. P'Ru, playing this character was really immersive.
translated: 等到真正進劇組開拍的時候 真的超級好玩 演這個角色讓人非常入戲

original: We fell in love with the character, and the character became part of us. We gave ourselves to the character, and the character gave something back to us.
translated: 我們愛上了這個角色 角色也融入了我們 我們把靈魂給了角色 角色也給了我們回饋

original: I got excited along with the character, too. Oh, I really love this series. I was like...
translated: 我也跟著這個角色一起興奮起來 我真的好愛這部劇 當時整個人就像是

original: Really? [Laughter]
translated: 真的嗎 笑聲

original: I have to say, there are things I wouldn't do. So let me ask: was there any scene during filming that you found especially difficult?
translated: 我必須說 有些事情平常我絕對不會做 所以我想問 在拍攝過程中有哪場戲覺得特別困難嗎

original: The hardest scene? "Spread your legs."
translated: 覺得最難的戲嗎 腳張開 那場

original: Like... The "spread your legs" scene.
translated: 就是 腳張開 那場戲

original: Wait...
translated: 等等

original: The "spread your legs" scene? [Laughter] Whose legs are we talking about? We couldn't even get through reading it—let alone filming it!
translated: 腳張開 那場戲嗎 笑聲 到底是張開誰的腳啦 當初光是讀劇本都讀不下去了 更別說正式開拍

original: From the very first script reading, we couldn't say "spread your legs" out loud. It was so awkward.
translated: 從第一次讀劇本開始 我們就完全說不出口 腳張開 這句話 真的太尷尬了

original: Why? Even Farang had to repeat it: "Spread your legs." [Laughter]
translated: 為什麼 就連 Pan 也要跟著唸 腳張開 笑聲

original: I couldn't read it. "Spread your legs."
translated: 我當初真的唸不出來 腳張開 這句

original: "Spread your legs." Why? What's wrong?
translated: 腳張開 為什麼 怎麼了嗎

original: I just couldn't say it. I couldn't do it. P'Boom, when someone conservative like me comes across something like this...
translated: 我真的講不出口 真的做不到 P'Boom 像我這麼保守的人 突然碰上這種台詞

original: ...it's a shock. It's a culture shock. I was thinking, "I would never do this."
translated: 真的嚇傻了 完全是文化衝擊 我心裡想 我這輩子絕對不會做這種事

original: I was like, "No way!" when I read it. But when the actual filming day came, there were certain key words...
translated: 我讀本時整個人完全傻眼 可是到了正式開拍那天 劇本裡有幾個關鍵字

original: ...that I discussed with the director, and then I just went for it. Maybe it was because, as this character...
translated: 我和導演討論過後 也就硬著頭皮直接上了 也許是因為演這個角色

original: ...I was playing the younger one who brings everyone happiness in the story, you know?
translated: 我在戲裡飾演的是能帶給大家快樂的年下妹妹 妳懂嗎

original: We were selling the idea of spending time together, but there wasn't any physical contact, so it was different.
translated: 我們主打的是陪伴彼此的感覺 沒有肢體接觸 所以感覺完全不一樣

original: Right. Was there a scene that you felt you absolutely couldn't do?
translated: 沒錯 那有沒有哪一場戲是妳覺得自己絕對做不到的

original: There was only one. It was this scene.
translated: 只有那一場 就是那一場戲

original: That was the hardest "spread your legs" scene for me. Because with action scenes, sometimes...
translated: 對我來說 腳張開 那場真的是大魔王 因為動作戲的話 有時候

original: ...it's not embarrassing. I mean, doing it with P'Inna is fine. But when you actually have to say those words...
translated: 倒不會覺得害羞 和 P'Lena 一起演動作戲完全沒問題 可是當妳必須把那些字說出口

original: ...as part of an action you have to perform, it feels embarrassing and uncomfortable. Saying the words is awkward.
translated: 而且還要搭配具體動作時 就會覺得好害羞好不自在 說出那些台詞真的好難為情

original: Okay, because in that scene you're sitting on someone's lap, and Farang is sitting behind you. Then Farang says...
translated: 因為那場戲是妳坐在人家腿上 Pan 坐在妳身後 然後 Pan 說了那句

original: "Spread your legs." "Spread your legs."
translated: 腳張開 腳張開

original: And then P'Kook wouldn't do it! [Laughter]
translated: 結果 P'Kook 還死不肯照做 笑聲

original: But in the end, it all worked out. I'd say that was the hardest thing for me.
translated: 不過最後還是順利拍完了 我覺得那對我來說是難度最高的一場戲

original: Oh, it wasn't that hard when we actually filmed it. It wasn't as difficult as reading it. P'Ao made it easier because...
translated: 真正開拍時其實沒那麼難 沒有讀本時那麼痛苦 P'Ao 幫了大忙 因為

original: ...she only gave us 20 minutes. Exactly. We had no choice but to just go for it.
translated: 她那時候只給我們二十分鐘 沒錯 我們根本沒得選 只能硬著頭皮直接來

original: She said, "Don't say anything. Just do it, do it! We're running out of time, and the crew needs to wrap up."
translated: 她說 不要講話 快點做 快點拍 時間快不夠了 劇組得準時收工

original: P'Ao was going to say, "Please help Mom, darling." [Screaming] No!
translated: P'Ao 當時還差點說出 寶貝 快幫幫媽媽吧 尖叫聲 救命喔

original: Everyone just gave it their all. And what about you, Lena? Was there a scene you found really difficult?
translated: 大家真的都拚盡全力 那 Lena 呢 有哪場戲是妳覺得特別困難的嗎

original: A really difficult one? The dramatic scenes? Oh, but we're great at drama! Was it really that hard? Which scene?
translated: 特別難的嗎 哭戲嗎 我們明明很擅長演情緒戲 真的有那麼難嗎 哪一場

original: I think the scenes where the character has to feel shy are difficult, especially when the character has to hide her feelings.
translated: 我覺得角色需要表現出害羞靦腆的戲很難 尤其是角色必須把情緒藏在心裡的時候

original: Of course, dramatic scenes are difficult, too. But the scene where she puts on the apron...
translated: 當然 情緒戲也很難 但那場繫圍裙的戲

original: ...that scene was so embarrassing. It was really embarrassing, but Pim couldn't show that she was flustered.
translated: 那場戲真的讓人超級害羞 真的害羞到不行 可是 Pheem 表面上又不能露出慌亂的破綻

original: So it created this tension. I wanted to smile, but I couldn't. I had to keep Pim's expression straight...
translated: 所以整個人內心都在天人交戰 我明明想笑 可是不能笑 必須維持 Pheem 一臉正經的模樣

original: ...and keep a straight face the whole time. That's why...
translated: 全程都得繃著一張撲克臉 所以那時候

original: ...it felt so awkward. Honestly, I wanted to show how I really felt. If I were playing myself, I would have jumped...
translated: 感覺真的超級憋 如果是換作我自己的個性 我早就直接撲上去了

original: ...right into it. But when I was Pim, I had to hold back.
translated: 但因為演的是 Pheem 我必須硬生生壓抑下來

original: "The food doesn't taste good," or something like that. Yeah, just a little bit of acting there.
translated: 裝模作樣說一句 菜做得不怎麼樣 類似這樣 就是要演得很傲嬌

original: Honestly, the hardest scenes are the ones where we have to hold back our real emotions.
translated: 老實說 最難拍的反而是那些必須把真實情感硬生生壓抑住的戲

original: Exactly. Oh!
translated: 沒錯 哎呀

original: Hey, what do you mean? [Laughter] You have to keep your emotions in check.
translated: 等等 妳這話是什麼意思 笑聲 妳必須好好克制住自己的情緒才行

original: Keep your emotions in check. But hold on a moment. Please put your cameras away. The staff can see who's livestreaming.
translated: 克制情緒是吧 不過先稍等一下 請大家把手機收起來 工作人員有看到現場有人在直播喔

original: Excuse me, everyone. If you're holding up your phones and livestreaming right now...
translated: 不好意思各位 如果你們手上正拿著手機在開直播的話

original: ...please stop livestreaming. Thank you, everyone. We really appreciate your cooperation.
translated: 請大家立刻停止直播 謝謝大家 真的非常感謝各位的配合

original: All right, let's continue. We need to switch gears a little because some people came here specifically...
translated: 好了 我們繼續 稍微轉換一下氣氛 因為有些粉絲是特地買票來到現場

original: ...for this exclusive experience, and we're livestreaming it right now. The people who couldn't get tickets...
translated: 為了享受這份專屬的現場體驗 如果現在開直播 那些沒搶到票的朋友們

original: ...would be disappointed. They went to so much effort for these two, and we shouldn't take advantage of that.
translated: 心裡一定會很難過 大家為了這兩位女孩付出這麼多心血 我們可不能佔大家便宜

original: We can't do that. If you really love the girls, please don't do it. Don't, okay?
translated: 這樣真的不行 如果大家真的很愛這兩位女孩 請千萬不要開直播 好嗎

original: So modern! [Sigh] Very modern indeed. Now, speaking of the filming...
translated: 真會跟隨潮流 嘆氣 真的很跟得上時代 好了 說回到拍攝這件事

original: ...and the challenges involved, was there any scene that really touched you or left an impression? P'Ao, was there one?
translated: 以及過程中所面臨的挑戰 有沒有哪一場戲是特別觸動妳或讓妳印象深刻的 P'Ao 有嗎

original: Was there a scene you filmed and thought, "I really love this! I'm so proud of this work"?
translated: 有沒有哪一場戲是妳拍完當下心想 我真的好愛這場戲 我為這個作品感到非常驕傲

original: I love... So many scenes!
translated: 我很喜歡的戲嗎 實在太多場了

original: You can't tell us about the ending scene! Oh, you like the ending scene? Then you won't have to say anything... Wait, I don't know!
translated: 妳可不能爆雷大結局的戲喔 喔 妳最喜歡結局的戲嗎 那妳就什麼都不能講了 等等 我也不知道啦

original: That makes it pretty hard for the host to continue! But really, when you're working on a project...
translated: 這樣主持人很難接下去主持耶 不過說真的 在製作一個作品的時候

original: ...you have to love almost every scene, because if we don't love them, the audience will never love them either.
translated: 幾乎每一場戲我們都必須全心去愛 因為如果連我們自己都不愛 觀眾又怎麼可能會喜歡

original: ...at all. Mm-hmm.
translated: 真的完全不可能喜歡 嗯嗯

original: So there may be some scenes that feel more special than others, such as the scene where Dee cries...
